risks.title: Key developer resignation
risks.description: The lead backend engineer has received a competing offer and may leave before delivery.

risks.title: Payment gateway API deprecation
risks.description: The third-party payment API has announced an upcoming version sunset.

risks.title: Scope creep from stakeholders
risks.description: Product owners have a history of adding features mid-sprint without timeline adjustment.

risks.title: Cloud infrastructure cost overrun
risks.description: Estimated AWS costs may be exceeded if traffic spikes during load testing.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance delay
risks.description: New data privacy regulations may require additional audit before go-live.

risks.title: Third-party logistics integration
risks.description: Logistics provider API has limited documentation and poor support response times.

risks.title: UI design sign-off delay
risks.description: Design approvals historically take longer than planned due to stakeholder availability.

risks.title: Test environment instability
risks.description: The staging environment has had intermittent outages affecting QA cycles.

risks.title: Vendor delivery delay
risks.description: Hardware procurement for on-premise components may be delayed by supply chain issues.

risks.title: Team communication breakdown
risks.description: Distributed team across time zones may cause coordination delays on cross-functional tasks.
